name: Saldean's Farm
summary: Saldean's Farm is the only homestead in Westfall that has not been completely overrun and abandoned to the Defias Brotherhood. Held by the stubborn Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma, the farmhouse remains a rare safe haven amid the region's turmoil.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Dust
sections.body: While neighboring lands fell to banditry and mechanical sabotage, the Saldean family refused to abandon their soil. Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma have stayed on their homestead, offering hot food and a kind word to passing travelers. Despite their resilience, the fields remain plagued by rogue harvest golems deployed across the plains, forcing the family to stay close to the farmhouse walls.

sections.title: Holding the Line
sections.body: Because the Stormwind crown has largely neglected Westfall, law enforcement here is thin. A handful of Sentinel Hill and Stormwind guards patrol the periphery, but the farm survives primarily through sheer grit and the aid of passing travelers. For the Saldeans, Salma's famous Westfall stew and goretusk liver pie and the shelter of their farmhouse are small comforts against the ever-present threat of the Defias.

faq.q: Why is this farm still standing when the others fell?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean and his wife simply refused to pack up and flee when the Defias Brotherhood swept through Westfall. Though hostile harvest golems prowl their crops, the family stubbornly defends the immediate perimeter with the help of passing militia and adventurers.

faq.q: Who are all the people gathered around the house?
faq.answer: The farm's residents are Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma; anyone else you find there is likely a passing traveler, as the couple welcome visitors and the adventurers willing to help them with the dangers plaguing their fields.

faq.q: Why are mechanical golems attacking the fields?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood repurposed the region's mechanical harvest reapers and golems into deadly sentries. They roam the fields attacking anyone who attempts to cultivate or clear the land.

faq.q: Is the Stormwind Army protecting the farm?
faq.answer: Official military presence is practically nonexistent. A few scattered guards from Sentinel Hill and Stormwind provide minimal watch, but the crown has largely left Westfall's defense to local initiative.

angles.text: Saldean's Farm represents the raw, failing edge of the kingdom's frontier, exposing how deeply ordinary citizens suffer when Stormwind's leadership is distracted.
Salma Saldean is renowned among travelers for turning scavenged Westfall ingredients into hearty, lifesaving dishes like Goretusk Liver Pie.
